correctness.rationale: For \(u>0\), the equilibrium equations imply \((a+mu-u^2)v=1=(b+cu+du^2)v\). Eliminating \(v\) gives \(F(u)=(1+d)u^2+(c-m)u+b-a=0\), but reconstructing \(v\) also requires \(a+mu-u^2>0\). Since \(a>0\), this concave quadratic is positive for positive \(u\) exactly when \(0<u<	au=(m+\sqrt{m^2+4a})/2\). On the source branch \(b=a\), \(m>c\), substituting \(u=(m-c)/(1+d)\) gives the exact numerator \(a(1+d)^2+(m-c)(md+c)\). At \(a=b=d=m=1\), \(c=-3\), the only positive quadratic root is \(u=2\), for which \(v=-1\); thus the source's listed case can contain no positive equilibrium. The universal criterion is symbolic and does not depend on finite enumeration.
